summary: Recomputes 3D positional-audio parameters for one sound source relative to a listener: distance attenuation, stereo pan split and Doppler-influenced playback rate, then pushes them to the Miles audio layer through the AIL sample handle and manages sample start/position/resume state. Sound-source position, listener position and the Doppler reference are read from this and from a listener object reached through this+0x54.

operations.description: Read the behavior bitmask at this+0x18 into a working copy and the baseline attenuation float at this+0x40 (the reference level before distance scaling).

Resolve the listener pointer stored at this+0x54 (position/direction source object) and the Miles sample-information pointer at this+0x58; the listener-relative position read window starts at listener offset 0x58.
If the state flag at this+0x14 equals 1, consult the virtual state query through the vtable (object base at this+0x0, slot obj+0x1C); a return other than 1 keeps the playback path enabled.

Compute the source-to-listener delta vector from source position at this+0x28, this+0x2C, this+0x30 minus listener position at listener offsets 0x58, 0x5C, 0x60, then the Euclidean distance via sqrt of the squared sum.
If behavior bitmask this+0x18 bit 3 (value 8) is clear, run the distance through SmoothstepInterpolation and adopt the result as the attenuation scale.
Normalize the delta vector by the inverse distance (1/dist, guarded against a zero distance) into direction components used by the pan/attenuation helpers.
If the playback path is active (state flag this+0x14 not suppressed) and bitmask bit 0 is clear, feed the normalized direction to ScaledDotProductWithClamp.
If bitmask bits 2 or 3 are clear, compute the stereo pan factor via DotProductWithScaleOffset on the direction vector.
Derive the two channel volume levels: near = pan * attenuation, far = (1 - pan) * attenuation.
Apply the channel volume levels to the Miles sample handle read at offset 0x10 of the sample-information object (AIL_set_sample_volume_levels).
Compute the playback rate as the listener Doppler reference at listener offset 0x8C multiplied by the two rate components at this+0x48 and this+0x44.
Apply the playback rate to the sample handle (AIL_set_sample_playback_rate).
Run the follow-up sample-state computation ShortComputation_6100 on this.

If the playback path is active and bitmask bit 4 (value 0x10) is set, index the per-step position table flt_8AAE74 with the rolling byte counter dword_8AAE70, convert via CRTFtol, set the sample position, then resume the sample.
Otherwise, when the playback path is active, start the sample (AIL_start_sample).
Return 0 on every exit path. Called from MilesAudioSamplePlaybackSetup (0x00405900) to keep the positional sample updated.

unresolved: The object referenced by field:obj:0x0000001C is the vtable of the sound-source object itself; its state query semantics are caller-defined.
The precise meaning of the this+0x18 bitmask bits (0, 2, 3, 4) is inferred from the branch structure of the raw text and not independently confirmed.
The relationship between the listener object at this+0x54 and the sample-information object at this+0x58 is not expressed in the raw text.
